summary: Assign gateway source paths to workstreams

delivery.outcome: Every tracked gateway path is owned by exactly one workstream, so product tickets (performance fixes and the benchmark) can be allocated.
nonGoals: Change gateway code, tests, docs or CI behaviour
Change ownership already assigned by the managed base manifest

architecture.decision: Extend only the target-owned .governance/manifest.json: application owns data_gateway/** and benchmarks/**; integration owns dependency manifests, upstream lock, Makefile, tools and the error catalog; infrastructure owns the CI workflow. No responsibility moves between workstreams: every listed path was previously owned by none.
architecture.rollback: Close the PR; after publication revert through a new governance ticket.
